content.comment_body: Hello. I am new to [product_name]. I am experiencing an issue I can't resolve. When I press a button, I want the output to be active from 6 to 17 o'clock on weekdays. Outside of those hours, the output should only remain on for 2 hours. On weekends, it should stay on for 2 hours when the button is pressed. Appreciate any help.
Hi [user_name], welcome to the forum. Your explanation is a bit unclear. Could you clarify when the button is pressed?

I press the button when I want to turn on the outlet. It's for a coffee machine that should turn off by itself. So when the customer arrives in the morning, she presses the button. If it's 7 o'clock, the machine stays on until 17 o'clock. If it's 19 o'clock, it only stays on for 2 hours. On weekends, pressing the button means it's only on for 2 hours.
I hope I understood your requirements correctly...
Hi [user_name], glad I could assist you ...

analysis.insight_summary: A new user is working with [product_name] and is seeking help to configure output logic based on specific time and day parameters for an automation scenario. The thread exposes how beginners face challenges in programming conditional schedules in [product_name] software, but shows that with clear communication, constructive support is available.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects an accessible way to set logic blocks or program output functions based on changing time conditions for weekdays and weekends. They want the product to easily manage practical time-based automation tasks, even for users without much experience.
